Heap phase: maximum V8 old-space for the isolated inert-script analyzer, in MiB (default 1024, range 128..16384). Omitted means 1024 and applies on the next call. Per-script deadline phase: maximum startup, analysis and result transfer time for one captured script, in milliseconds (default 30000, range 1..2147483647). Omitted means 30000. deadlineExpired for one script is not total_analysis_timeout_ms. A per-script value above the effective total is rejected. Timed-out scripts are explicit unknowns and other scripts may still be analyzed. Applies on the next call.

Total analysis deadline phase: maximum time for all captured-script analysis, in milliseconds (default 300000, range 1..2147483647). Omitted means 300000. This is not the per-script analysis_timeout_ms, not capture, and not source-map fetch. A per-script timeout above this total is rejected. Unstarted scripts remain explicit unknowns. Applies on the next call.

Source-map fetch deadline in milliseconds (default 30000). Omitted means 30000 and applies on the next fetch. A fetch overrun is an item limitation (fetch_failed), not a thrown analysis timeout. Does not raise the fixed 64 MiB response budget or the source-map decode deadline. The response budget has no runtime override.
